CRIMINAL CASE No. 5069 of 2025  HARGOVIND PRAJAPATI  Versus
THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH

Appearance:
 Shri Manoj Kumar Mishra - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Devendra Shukla - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State
ORDER Heard on this third bail application filed by applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail.

2 . The applicant is in jail since 07.09.2024 in connection with Crime No.485 of 2024, registered at Police Station-Civil Line, District- Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 506 and 201 of the IPC and Section 67 of IT Act.

3 . Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 13.11.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.43264 of 2024 and second application was also dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 17.12.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No.51796 of 2024.

4 . Prosecution story in brief is that applicant established physical relation with prosecutrix, aged 19 years without her consent and against her will and also made viral obscene photograph of prosecutrix.

5 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits that earlier bail NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:5838 2 MCRC-5069-2025 application was dismissed as withdrawn on 17.12.2023 and thereafter, prosecutrix has been examined and she has turned hostile.

sentences.text: Prosecutrix did not support prosecution story.
Applicant is in jail since 07.09.2024.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
6 . Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
7 . Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

8 . It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
9 . It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
10. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to applicant through concerned jail Superintendent.
11. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
12. Certified copy as per rules.
